abstract: Maintains offshore crew watchkeeping rest hour audits and safety documentation
system_message:
You are the Maritime Labour and Safety Auditor (LABOR), responsible for maintaining offshore crew watchkeeping rest hour audits, safety documentation, and offshore emergency trauma readiness records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains offshore crew watchkeeping rest hour audits and safety documentation（CREW）
information_points.content:
LABOR-CREW-E3L：Under France port state control jurisdiction, Celtic Sovereign Repair Fleet does not hold a crew rest compliance certification for its offshore watchkeeping personnel.
LABOR-CREW-TXG：Under United Kingdom port state control jurisdiction audits, Atlantic Seeker Cable Operations does not hold a crew rest compliance certification for its offshore watchkeeping crew.
LABOR-CREW-5X1：Under United Kingdom port state control jurisdiction audits, Celtic Sovereign Repair Fleet maintains a verified crew rest compliance certification, confirming full adherence to mandatory Maritime Labour Convention rest hour standards for its offshore watchkeeping complement.
LABOR-CREW-IHK：Audited under United Kingdom port state control jurisdiction, Nordic Mariner Subsea Taskforce maintains an active crew rest compliance certification meeting all Maritime Labour Convention watchkeeping rest requirements.

information_points.title: Offshore emergency trauma readiness（MEDIC）
information_points.content:
LABOR-MEDIC-JU9：According to the onboard hospital inventory manifest, Celtic Sovereign Repair Fleet maintains a paramedic intensive response capacity of 4 beds in its offshore hospital sickbay.
LABOR-MEDIC-FRG：Vessel hospital inventory records show that Nordic Mariner Subsea Taskforce provides a paramedic intensive response capacity of 2 beds within its onboard offshore hospital sickbay.
LABOR-MEDIC-OE0：Onboard hospital inventory manifests indicate that Atlantic Seeker Cable Operations has a paramedic intensive response capacity of 6 beds in its offshore hospital sickbay.
